Do I pay for the sync tool?
Yes. Most sync tools bill monthly, and you pay the tool maker directly. We pick an option that fits your size, tell you the cost first and set it up in your own accounts.

desc:
An eBay inventory sync keeps the stock numbers on eBay and in your own online store identical, so you stop selling items you no longer have. Ecom Swift LLC connects the two channels with a sync tool that fits your platform, maps products by SKU and tests the result.

## Why do eBay and store stock numbers drift apart?

Stock numbers drift because each channel counts on its own. A sale on eBay reduces eBay stock only, and a sale in your store reduces store stock only. Unless something passes that change across, the two numbers disagree after the first order, and the gap grows with every sale, return and manual edit.

The usual result is an oversell. A buyer pays for an item that is already gone, you cancel, and the buyer is left annoyed. On eBay a cancellation by the seller can count against your record, so the problem costs more than one lost sale.

## How a single stock count protects your account

Overselling hurts in three places at once: the buyer who waits, the seller record that takes a defect, and your time spent writing apologies. A sync tool removes the cause by treating one place as the source of truth and updating the other channel after each sale.

It also frees you from checking two dashboards by hand. When stock updates itself, you can reorder on time, hide sold-out items in both places and spend your hours on products instead of spreadsheets. The speed of the update depends on the tool and on each platform's own limits, which is why we test rather than assume.

## What a reliable eBay sync includes

- One SKU for every product, written the same way in both places.
- A clear decision about which system holds the master stock count.
- A sync tool that supports both eBay and your store platform.
- Variation listings mapped so each size or color has its own count.
- A buffer rule for low stock, so the last unit is not sold twice.
- An out of stock rule that ends or hides the listing at zero.
- Duplicate and blank SKUs found and fixed before the connection goes live.
- A test sale on each side, with the result written down.
- A short guide for what to check when a number looks wrong.

## What we do

First we look at your eBay listings and your store catalog and compare the SKUs. Blanks, duplicates and spelling differences are the most common cause of failed matches, so we list them and correct them with you. Then we pick a sync tool that works with your store platform and connect it to both accounts.

We map products one by one, set the low stock and out of stock rules, and place a test order on each channel. We confirm that stock falls on both sides and write down the steps. The Standard package adds a weekly check routine, and the Premium package covers variations, up to two sales channels and a repair guide for mismatches. The tool subscription is paid by you directly to the tool maker.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Give every product a unique SKU before connecting anything.
- Keep a small safety buffer on fast-moving items.
- Run the weekly check we write for you, even when things look fine.
- Edit stock in the master system only, not in both places.
- Tell us before you change product structure or rename items.

**Avoid:**
- Typing stock changes by hand on both channels.
- Reusing one SKU for different products or sizes.
- Switching on the sync before the SKU clean-up is done.
- Importing a large catalog all at once without a test.
- Assuming a sync is instant, since tools run on their own schedule.

## Who this is for

This service suits a store owner who started on their own site and added eBay as a second channel and now sees mismatched counts. It also suits a seller with one-of-a-kind and multi-quantity items who wants control over each, and a small team that has been fixing stock by hand every evening.

## What we need from you

We need to know which platform your store runs on, roughly how many listings you have and which channel should hold the master count. Please send a product export from each side if you can. We never need your passwords. We work as a collaborator or staff user in your store and with the access the sync tool offers, so the accounts stay yours.
